changeRequests.title: Marketing Process Management
changeRequests.description: Create, maintain, and evolve marketing processes as connected sequences of meaningful steps.

changeRequests.title: Process Node Management
changeRequests.description: Create, edit, remove, and independently document nodes that represent individual marketing activities.

changeRequests.title: Process Flow Reordering and Splitting
changeRequests.description: Reorder process nodes, split existing steps into multiple nodes, and update the process flow as requirements change.

changeRequests.title: Node Relationship Management
changeRequests.description: Connect nodes, define successor nodes, and manage the transitions that determine how a marketing process proceeds.

changeRequests.title: Level 1 Process Definition
changeRequests.description: Document what must happen at each process step independently of tools, software, people, APIs, or implementation details.

changeRequests.title: Level 2 Implementation Documentation
changeRequests.description: Document how each process step is currently performed, including operational procedures, responsible activities, and implementation details.

changeRequests.title: Implementation-Independent Process Modeling
changeRequests.description: Keep the fundamental process definition separate from its current implementation so implementation changes do not alter the business process.

changeRequests.title: Node Input and Output Definition
changeRequests.description: Define the inputs required by each node and the outputs or results produced after the node is completed.

changeRequests.title: Node Notes and Supplemental Documentation
changeRequests.description: Add notes and other relevant supporting information to individual process nodes.

changeRequests.title: Manual Activity Documentation
changeRequests.description: Record which parts of a node's implementation are performed manually and document the associated manual work.

changeRequests.title: Automated Activity Documentation
changeRequests.description: Record which parts of a node's implementation are automated and document the associated automated behavior.

changeRequests.title: Automation Status Management
changeRequests.description: Classify node automation as none, partially automated, fully automated, or planned to communicate current and future automation maturity.

changeRequests.title: Automation Rule Definition
changeRequests.description: Document automation behavior for a node by defining its description, trigger, conditions, and resulting actions.

changeRequests.title: Event Trigger Configuration
changeRequests.description: Define the events or situations that initiate automated processing for a node, such as submission of a new lead.

changeRequests.title: Automation Condition Management
changeRequests.description: Specify prerequisites and validation conditions that must be satisfied before automated actions execute.

changeRequests.title: Automated Action Sequencing
changeRequests.description: Define and order the actions performed automatically after a trigger and its conditions are satisfied, such as creating leads, identifying campaigns, recording sources, starting nurture processes, and notifying responsible users.

changeRequests.title: Tool and Application Association
changeRequests.description: Associate process nodes with the websites, applications, documents, forms, APIs, dashboards, and internal systems used to perform them.

changeRequests.title: Resource URL Management
changeRequests.description: Add, organize, and maintain named links to operational resources such as campaign forms, landing pages, lead systems, and dashboards.

changeRequests.title: Structured Process Specification
changeRequests.description: Capture process definitions, node data, implementation details, resources, relationships, and automation rules in structured information that can serve as the authoritative process specification.

changeRequests.title: Database Model Generation
changeRequests.description: Use structured process documentation to generate database models for implementing the documented marketing processes.

changeRequests.title: API Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate APIs from the documented process structure, node definitions, and automation requirements.

changeRequests.title: Workflow Engine Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate workflow-engine components that execute documented node sequences, transitions, conditions, and actions.

changeRequests.title: Task Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate operational tasks from documented process steps and automation definitions.

changeRequests.title: Notification Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate notifications, including alerts to responsible people, from documented automation actions and process events.

changeRequests.title: Integration Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate integrations with the tools, applications, APIs, and internal systems referenced by documented process nodes.

changeRequests.title: Automation Code Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate automation implementations from documented triggers, conditions, and actions.

changeRequests.title: Dashboard Generation
changeRequests.description: Generate dashboards based on the structured marketing process documentation and its operational data requirements.

requirements.title: Marketing Process Node Management
requirements.description: Document a marketing process as a chain of connected nodes, each with Level 1 (what) and Level 2 (how) documentation, automation status, and tool/URL references. Nodes can be added, removed, reordered, or split as the process evolves.
